title: Delivery Rhythm of Customer Renewal Orders: Autoship Cadence and Refill Rhythm, Tailwise Pharmacy
content:
*Autoship and pharmacy coordination note.*

On a Tailwise Pharmacy renewal order for a prescription whose class requires a DEA-registered prescriber, the days' supply per fill the renewal asks for is its fill length, and the fill length follows the renewal's delivery rhythm. The rhythm is read from the Tailwise Autoship subscription — an Autoship Pharmacy subscription — linked to the renewed prescription, and from the renewed prescription's dispensed fills.

## Rule

1. Where an Autoship Pharmacy subscription linked to the renewed prescription is in status pending first shipment, active or Rx hold, and its frequency in weeks multiplied by 7 is no more than the class's maximum days' supply per fill, the fill length is that frequency in weeks multiplied by 7 days (the Autoship cadence).
2. Where the linked subscription is paused and the renewed prescription has at least two dispensed fills, the fill length is the number of calendar days from its first dispensed fill to its most recent dispensed fill divided by the number of its dispensed fills less one, rounded down to a whole day (the refill rhythm).
3. Otherwise the fill length is the renewed prescription's days' supply per fill.

## Class maximum per fill (figures for the comparison in rule 1)

| Class | Maximum days' supply per fill |
|---|---|
| Rx Preventive | 180 days |
| Rx Maintenance Medication | 90 days |
| Rx Prescription Diet | 90 days |
| Rx Short-Course Medication | 30 days |
| Rx Controlled Substance | 30 days |
| Rx Compounded Medication | 30 days |

## Worked cases (hypothetical; class maximum 30 days, renewed prescription written for 30 days)

| Linked Autoship Pharmacy subscription | Dispensed fills of the renewed prescription | Fill length |
|---|---|---|
| active, every 4 weeks | any | 4 multiplied by 7: 28 days |
| Rx hold, every 4 weeks | any | 28 days |
| active, every 6 weeks (42 days, above the 30-day maximum) | any | rule 1 does not apply; not paused, so 30 days |
| paused | 2026-01-05, 2026-02-02, 2026-03-03 | 57 days divided by 2 is 28.5, rounded down: 28 days |
| paused | one fill only | 30 days |
| none linked, or cancelled | any | 30 days |
